body.purpose: Base text and inherited form controls.

label.purpose: Header link and footer settings action.

collection-field.purpose: The manual GIF collection textarea; inherits the system UI family and line height.

extensions.themeBehavior: Explicit data-theme light/dark; system dark preference applies unless explicitly light. Picker receives GitHub theme at open.
extensions.extractionNotes: Extracted from outputs/jatoGifs/extension/ui.css, content.js, picker.html, options.html and privacy.html. No generated tonal ramps: only implemented values are documented. Component fallback values are the existing light theme; inherited semantic CSS properties provide dark theme. No config.js content read. Version 1.1.0 delta: manual collection textarea, existing save/check button variants and collection result region extracted from ui.css and options.html.

components.name: Manual Collection
components.description: Version 1.1.0 collection editor, using the existing field and action styles.
components.html: Un enlace o ID por línea, hasta 100 GIF de tonela10. Se guardan solo los ID, no las imágenes ni sus URL de archivo.
components.css: .ds-collection-label{font:14px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;display:block;font-weight:600;margin:22px 0 7px;color:var(--ink,#1f2328)}.ds-collection-field{font:13px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d1d9e0);border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#1f2328);caret-color:var(--accent,#0969da);resize:vertical;min-height:150px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-collection-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#0969da);outline-offset:3px}.ds-collection-help{font:14px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;max-width:65ch;color:var(--muted,#59636e)}.ds-collection-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0}.ds-collection-save,.ds-collection-check{font:14px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--line,#d1d9e0);border-radius:6px;padding:7px 12px;background:var(--subtle,#f6f8fa);color:var(--ink,#1f2328);font-weight:600}.ds-collection-check:hover{background:var(--selected,#ddf4ff)}.ds-collection-save{background:#1f883d;color:#fff;border-color:#1f883d}.ds-collection-save:hover{background:#1a7f37}.ds-collection-save:focus-visible,.ds-collection-check:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#0969da);outline-offset:3px}.ds-collection-save:disabled,.ds-collection-check:disabled{opacity:.65;cursor:wait}.ds-collection-result{font:14px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;min-height:24px;color:var(--ink,#1f2328)}.ds-collection-result[data-error="true"]{color:var(--danger,#b42318)}

narrative.overview:
The approved direction is a compact, Spanish, GitHub-native interface. System typography, familiar blue accents and light/dark surfaces keep attention on choosing a GIF and returning to the conversation editor. This document records the implemented extension rather than proposing a new visual identity.

The gallery is dense and practical. GIF imagery supplies the visual variety; framing, labels and controls remain restrained. Settings and privacy reuse the same palette and type system in a wider reading layout.
keyCharacteristics: Compact Spanish controls and status copy.
System fonts and GitHub-compatible light/dark themes.
Three-column GIF gallery with a narrow-width fallback.
Visible keyboard focus, selection outlines and attribution.
dos: **Do** preserve the compact Spanish interface and exact jatoGifs name.
**Do** apply light/dark values through the existing semantic surface, ink, line, accent and focus roles.
**Do** keep keyboard focus and selection clearly visible and maintain live status announcements.
**Do** preserve the official GIPHY attribution and the channel link.
**Do** use the existing system font and restrained outer-picker shadow.
donts: **Don't** add a new palette, font, decorative motif or animation while extending this documented interface.
**Don't** remove the narrow-width grid fallback or replace cropped GIF tiles with a different gallery model without a new approved direction.
**Don't** hide captions from keyboard focus or remove the visible focus treatment.
**Don't** treat a GIF choice as permission to submit the user's GitHub comment.
